data.title: D · 蜜月套房露台的解甲归真
data.description: 高层套房私密露台上夜风微凉。黑色晚礼裙拉链已滑至腰部，露出雪白光滑的美背。D反手轻按玻璃护栏仰头承受你的抚吻，呼吸促乱微颤，轻声承认自己早已假戏真做。
data.location: high-rise hotel suite balcony at midnight
data.action: back pressed against hotel balcony glass, evening gown zipper pulled down exposing smooth back, breathless panting as partner kisses her neck under night breeze
data.lighting: cool night skyline glow contrasting with warm suite interior spill
data.mood: vulnerable confession, moonlight sensuality, thrilling nocturnal romance
data.promptProse: Against a night hotel balcony with her evening gown zipper down, D pants breathlessly as partner kisses her neck in the cool night breeze.
data.animaCaption: D on a midnight balcony with unzipped gown receiving neck kisses.
